reading.title: Urban Green Spaces and Mental Health
reading.passage: Recent studies demonstrate that urban green spaces significantly improve mental health and well-being. Parks and gardens provide residents with natural environments that reduce stress and anxiety. Cities investing in green infrastructure report higher levels of citizen satisfaction and lower rates of depression. Research shows that even brief exposure to nature, such as walking through a park for fifteen minutes, can enhance mood and cognitive function. Urban planners increasingly recognize that incorporating trees, gardens, and natural areas into city design is essential for creating healthier, more livable communities.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one benefit of urban green spaces?
options: B) They reduce stress and anxiety
questions.explanation: 패시지에서 'Parks and gardens provide residents with natural environments that reduce stress and anxiety'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: How long does the passage suggest is needed to improve mood through nature exposure?
questions.explanation: 'walking through a park for fifteen minutes, can enhance mood and cognitive function'라는 문장에서 15분이 충분하다고 언급되었습니다. 정답은 C입니다.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: A) Parks are too expensive to maintain
B) Green spaces are important for urban mental health
C) Cities should eliminate all parks
D) Nature has no effect on humans
questions.explanation: 전체 패시지의 중심 주제는 도시 녹지 공간이 정신 건강에 미치는 긍정적인 영향입니다. 정답은 B입니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement: Technology has improved human relationships more than it has damaged them?

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현 (동의 또는 비동의). 예: 'I strongly agree that technology has positively impacted human relationships because...'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주장 - 기술이 장거리 연결을 가능하게 함. 소셜 미디어, 비디오 콜, 메시징 앱 등의 예시 제시
structure.body2: 두 번째 주장 - 기술이 면대면 상호작용을 감소시킬 수 있음. 스마트폰 과다 사용, 가족 모임 중 개인 기기 사용 등의 반대 관점 고려
structure.conclusion: 주요 아이디어 재정리 및 입장 재확인. 전체 논리의 일관성 확보

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer working in a team environment. Others prefer working independently. Which do you prefer and why?
sample_points: 팀 환경에서는 다양한 아이디어와 관점을 얻을 수 있으며, 협력을 통해 더 창의적인 해결책을 도출할 수 있습니다.
독립적 작업은 집중력이 높고 개인의 페이스대로 진행할 수 있으며, 더 효율적일 수 있습니다.

listening.title: Studying Abroad Decision
listening.script: Student: Hi Professor, I'm considering studying abroad next year, but I'm worried about leaving my family and friends. Do you think it's worth it? Professor: That's a great question. Studying abroad offers incredible opportunities. You'll gain independence, experience new cultures, and build international connections. Many of my former students said it was transformative. Student: But what about the cost? Isn't it very expensive? Professor: Yes, it can be. However, there are many scholarships available. Look into grants, government programs, and university partnerships. Also, many employers value international experience highly, so it might lead to better career prospects. Student: That's helpful. I hadn't considered the career benefits. Professor: One more thing—the homesickness is temporary, but the memories and skills you gain are permanent. I'd encourage you to apply.

questions.q: What is the student's main concern about studying abroad?
questions.explanation: 대화 초반에 학생이 'I'm worried about leaving my family and friends'라고 명시적으로 말했습니다. 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, what is one benefit of studying abroad?
options: C) It provides better career prospects
questions.explanation: 교수는 'many employers value international experience highly, so it might lead to better career prospects'라고 설명했습니다. 정답은 C입니다.

questions.q: What solutions does the professor suggest for the cost problem?
options: B) Look into scholarships and grants
questions.explanation: 교수는 'There are many scholarships available. Look into grants, government programs, and university partnerships'라고 조언했습니다. 정답은 B입니다.
